statusVocabulary.note: Technical checks, visual evidence and the owner's aesthetic acceptance are separate; no test result changes ownerAcceptance.

orientationAudit.rule: The runtime assigns positions, normals and indices verbatim and every measured donor frame is a proper rotation of Unity's, so a triangle's front is Cross(b - a, c - a); an inward component draws its inside under back-face culling, and opposing normals light visible faces from behind.
orientationAudit.caveat: Whether an inward mesh LOOKS wrong also depends on the donor material's cull mode; owner-accepted creatures with fully inward meshes (Crocodile, Bebelith) may sit on two-sided donor materials. Verify per donor before attributing a defect.

keySemantics: Normalized review/icon lookup label. Confirm the runtime catalog, exact CreatureKey and unit identity before editing; retained native entries can use different capitalization.
